identity.name: Kim Duk-soo
identity.summary: Korean janggu player, a child performer in the Namsadang troupe, who founded the SamulNori quartet in 1978 with Kim Yong-bae, Lee Kwang-soo and Choi Jong-sil, and the Hanullim orchestra after it disbanded in 1993.

contribution.description: Created the samul nori genre with SamulNori in 1978, putting the rural percussion of Korean pungmul on the stage; the style spread as other groups took it up.
